name: derived-processor-1-config-table
source: synthetic: values chosen by the vector deriver (processor 1, log levels 1,2,3,1,2,3,1 from Log_Level_Type, watchdog 30 s within 1-300, PROM read/write/erase/lock 100/200/5000/50 us within 10-50000); bytes derived by hand and with a standalone stdlib program, no engine or generator run. No kind of this pack maps a scaled value
reference: BogusSAT-2.xml Processor_Config_Table: Table_Processor_ID (IntegerDataEncoding with XTCE defaults, 8 bits unsigned), Config_Log_Levels (7 x Log_Level_Type, 4 bits unsigned, ends at bit 36), Config_Watchdog at LocationInContainerInBits 8 with referenceLocation absent (XTCE 1.2 default previousEntry: 8 bits after bit 36, so bits 36-43 skipped, watchdog at 44, 16 bits unsigned), Config_PROM_Access (4 x PROM_Programming_Access_Timing_Type, 16 bits unsigned), then Config_Self_Test whose first member is a BinaryParameterType (not mapped); Processor_1_Config_Table criterion PROCESSOR1=1; engine-spec 0.5 msb order and uint, 0.8 sequential (124 bits, last byte padded with zero bits), 0.30/0.33 window at 0 written from the as key
